title: Manifest signature extraction + license compatibility scanner for model onboarding
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Implement an automated scanner that extracts model manifests and cryptographic signatures, classifies license terms, and computes a license compatibility score used by onboarding gates. The scanner should surface clear remediation guidance, auto-quarantine ambiguous or incompatible artifacts, and push a human-review task into the legal queue when required. This ticket covers the product requirements, acceptance criteria, UI messaging for the Console onboarding flow, and the escalation rules for restricted weights or encumbered binaries.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest extraction runs for every model upload and outputs a standardized manifest.json with fields: name, version, weights_hashes, provenance_url, license_declared, license_files_detected, signature_present
Scanner computes a license_compatibility_score (0-100) using a ruleset and maps to gating decisions: allow(>=80), caution(50-79), quarantine(<50)
Uploads with restricted/encumbered weights or ambiguous license results automatically create a quarantined onboarding record and notify legal with required artifacts and a one-click release button
Console shows inline explanation for gating decisions, including detected license files, matched SPDX identifiers, and the confidence level of automated mapping
API returns structured metadata for each model: license_tags, compatibility_score, signature_status, quarantine_reason when applicable
Manual review SLA: legal must triage quarantined models within 3 business days; reviewer can mark resolved, request more info, or escalate to product/legal leadership
Audit log entries are created for every automated decision and for every reviewer action; logs are exportable via Console
Feature flags exist to enable/disable quarantine and to allow auto-accept for internal-trusted tenants
user_flow_steps: User uploads model bundle via Console or API
Ingestion service extracts any manifest and attached license files and computes cryptographic hashes for all weight files
Scanner runs license detection heuristics and signature validation in parallel
System calculates compatibility_score and applies gating policy
If quarantined, create legal review ticket with links to artifacts and recommended actions
If allowed or caution, publish model with a published_license metadata tag and optional warning banner in Console
heuristics_and_rules: Prefer declared license in manifest when matched to an SPDX id with >=90% token match
If no declared license, use license-files heuristic by scanning top-level files (LICENSE, COPYING, NOTICE) and applying fuzzy matching to SPDX phrases
Encumbered weights signatures: if weights are not signed or the signature chain doesn't match known provenance, increase risk score by 30
Binary provenance URL pointing to private storage or gated model zoos increases quarantine likelihood unless signed
Commercially incompatible licenses (e.g., GPLv3 in closed-source derivative) trigger automatic quarantine
Allowlist for permissive licenses (MIT/BSD/Apache-2.0) reduces risk score by 20 if corroborated by manifest
Custom enterprise allowlist can override quarantine with audit trail and co-signer approval
console_ui_copy: Onboarding Summary: We detected a declared license: Apache-2.0 (confidence: 96%). Compatibility score: 92 — model passes automated checks.
Quarantine Banner: This model has unclear or restricted licensing for weights. It will remain in Quarantine until reviewed by Legal. Provide provenance or a signed release to expedite.
Review Action Buttons: Request more info | Mark as Approved (legal) | Escalate to Product
API Response Notice: license_compatibility_score < 50 — model quarantined. See /console/models/<id>/compliance for details.
manual_review_checklist: Confirm provenance URLs and server-side storage access logs
Validate signatures against supplied public keys or known signers registry
Review license text for redistribution restrictions or patent clauses
If unknown license, contact uploader for clarification or request replacement weights
If acceptable under enterprise contract, annotate review with contract id and mark allowed
escalation_and_notifications: Automatic Slack/Email alert to #legal-onboarding with model id, uploader, and risk summary
PagerDuty trigger only for production-customer uploads with high risk where immediate rollback is required
Daily digest for pending quarantines older than 48 hours
Notification to uploader with instructions and link to show possible remediation steps
metrics_to_track: Median time to resolution for quarantined models
False positive rate measured by legal overrides
Distribution of compatibility_score across model sources
Number of models blocked due to encumbered weights per month
notes: We should avoid duplicating existing escrow flows; this ticket focuses on detection and gating rather than escrow mechanics
Consider integration with the provenance registry work to validate signatures in future phases
Prototype should include a rule editor for legal to tweak mapping from SPDX ids to compatibility scores
Privacy: Do not send full weight files to downstream third-party scanners — only hashes and extracted text artifacts
